column1:
PHASE 1: BEFORE (PROSPECT)
SQUARE 1: MY TARGET MARKET

• Primary Niche: Women 28–45 living in Chacarita, Colegiales, Villa Crespo, and Palermo who work desk/tech/corporate jobs and crave an off-screen, tactile, grounding creative escape.
• Secondary Niche: English-speaking expats and digital nomads living in Buenos Aires for 2–6 months seeking authentic creative activities and classes taught in English.
• Retail Niche (Mugs): Palermo design fair visitors and tourists looking for authentic, handmade Buenos Aires stoneware gifts and souvenirs.
• Who We Reject: Commercial wholesale café orders (low margin, consumes kiln capacity), children's birthday parties, and mass production.
column2:
PHASE 1: BEFORE (PROSPECT)
SQUARE 2: MY MESSAGE TO TARGET MARKET

• Core Message: "Tu momento de calma en la semana: clases de torno alfarero en grupos reducidos (máximo 6 personas) en Chacarita. Desconectá de las pantallas, reconectá con tus manos y llevate piezas que usás todos los días."
• English Hook: "Unplug from screens and get your hands in clay. Intimate wheel-throwing pottery classes in Chacarita, Buenos Aires. Spanish & English friendly."
• Unique Value Proposition:
  1. Dedicated wheel for every student (no waiting/sharing, max 6 per group).
  2. All-inclusive, transparent pricing (clay, glazes, and 2 firings included—no surprises).
  3. Calm garage sanctuary 10 min from Lacroze station, with tea, mate, and curated music.
• Call to Action: "Reservá tu torno por WhatsApp — cupos limitados a 6 personas."
column3:
PHASE 1: BEFORE (PROSPECT)
SQUARE 3: MEDIA I WILL USE TO REACH THEM

• Google Business Profile (Free): Claim "Taller Lento — Clases de Cerámica y Torno (Chacarita)" for high-intent local searches ("clases de cerámica chacarita", "pottery classes buenos aires").
• Palermo Design Fair (Transformed): Use the Sunday stall as a class lead generator, not just a mug shop. Tabletop QR sign + physical sign-up clipboard.
• Instagram Reels (@taller.lento): Post 2 Reels/week of wheel throwing, centering, and trimming (which get 5–10x views). Use calm ASMR audio and relatable text hooks ("3 horas sin celular"). Add English notes to captions.
• Meta/Instagram Boost (/mo ~ ARS 50,000): Boost top-performing Reel to women 25–45 within a 3km radius of Chacarita with a direct "Send WhatsApp Message" button.
• Local Chacarita Partnerships: Leave 20 stylish postcards at 3 friendly neighborhood specialty cafés near Lacroze station (/mo print budget).

column1:
PHASE 2: DURING (LEAD)
SQUARE 4: MY LEAD CAPTURE SYSTEM

• Stop the Fair Leak: Never say "follow me on Instagram." Instead, point to the table QR code and clipboard: "Anotate acá y te mando las fechas de la próxima clase antes de que se agoten."
• Tabletop QR Stand: Links directly to WhatsApp with pre-filled text: "Hola Lucía! Vi tus tazas en la feria de Palermo y quiero info de las clases de torno."
• Instagram Bio Overhaul: Replace cluttered Linktree with a clean bio stating location (Chacarita), group size (max 6), language (ES/EN), and a direct WhatsApp booking link.
• Lead Tracker Sheet: Simple Google Sheet ("Taller Lento — Contactos") with columns: Date, Name, WhatsApp, Source (Fair/IG/Google/Friend), Interest (Saturday/Wednesday/Taster/English), Status, and Follow-up Date.
column2:
PHASE 2: DURING (LEAD)
SQUARE 5: MY LEAD NURTURING SYSTEM

• WhatsApp Quick Reply (/info): Reply within 2–4 hours with a warm, personal message detailing class format, times, transparent pricing (ARS 120,000/mo), and 3 photos (the studio, hands on the wheel, finished glazed mugs).
• The Taster Bridge ("Probá el Torno"): When leads hesitate about committing to a full month, offer the 2.5-hour Saturday taster (ARS 40,000) as a low-risk way to experience the wheel.
• Wednesday Group Waitlist: Actively warm up inquiries for the upcoming Wednesday evening slot (19:00–22:00): "Ya tenemos 3 personas anotadas; abrimos en 2 semanas. ¿Te guardo un torno?"
• Pre-Class Welcome Kit: Send a short "What to expect & what to wear" message 48 hours before class (short nails, comfortable clothes, studio address, tea/mate provided) to build anticipation and reduce no-shows.
column3:
PHASE 2: DURING (LEAD)
SQUARE 6: MY SALES CONVERSION STRATEGY

• Frictionless Payment: Send Mercado Pago link (allows credit card/cuotas) or CVU/Alias bank transfer on WhatsApp. Secure the spot with a 50% deposit (seña).
• Taster-to-Monthly Conversion Pitch: At the end of the Taster class, while students hold their newly thrown pieces, offer: "Si te anotás hoy al grupo mensual de los sábados o miércoles, te bonifico .000 (el 50% del taster) en tu primera cuota."
• Finished Piece Pickup Conversion: When students return 3 weeks later to pick up their fired pieces, invite them to enroll in the upcoming monthly cycle while experiencing the excitement of holding their finished ceramic piece.
• Built-In Scarcity: Clearly communicate "Solo 6 tornos por grupo" to create natural urgency without artificial marketing pressure.

column1:
PHASE 3: AFTER (CUSTOMER)
SQUARE 7: DELIVERING A WORLD-CLASS EXPERIENCE

• Studio Sanctuary Vibe: Live up to "Taller Lento": warm garage lighting, relaxing indie/acoustic music, fresh tea, coffee, mate, and biscuits. A calm screen-free refuge.
• 100% Dedicated Wheel Time: Every student has their own wheel for the full 3 hours. Personalized, patient coaching tailored to individual progress.
• The "Clay Hands" Photo Service: Since students' hands are covered in clay, Lucía takes 3 aesthetic candid photos and a short video clip of each student on the wheel and sends them via WhatsApp right after class (students love sharing these on Instagram Stories, tagging @taller.lento).
• Thoughtful Packaging: Finished fired pieces are packed in recycled kraft paper tied with jute twine, complete with a handwritten care card ("Apto microondas y lavavajillas. Horneado con amor en Taller Lento").
column2:
PHASE 3: AFTER (CUSTOMER)
SQUARE 8: INCREASING CUSTOMER LIFETIME VALUE

• 3-Month Progression Roadmap (Stops Month 1 Drop-Off):
  - Month 1: Fundamentals of centering & cylinders (your first 4–6 mugs).
  - Month 2: Open forms, bowls, trimming techniques & pulling/attaching handles.
  - Month 3+: Advanced shapes (vases, teapots), decorative glazing & studio independence.
• Priority Re-enrollment Window: On Week 3, existing students get 72 hours of exclusive first dibs on their wheel for the next month before open seats are offered to the waitlist.
• Flexible Makeup Policy: Allow 1 makeup class per month (Saturday students can attend Wednesday evening, and vice versa), removing the "my schedule changed" cancellation excuse.
• Student Gift Discount: Enrolled students receive 20% off all Taller Lento mugs and bowls for gift purchases, turning them into regular retail customers.
column3:
PHASE 3: AFTER (CUSTOMER)
SQUARE 9: ORCHESTRATING REFERRALS

• "Vení con una Amiga" (Bring-a-Friend) Perk: If an existing student brings a friend who enrolls in the monthly class, both receive ARS 15,000 off their next month's fee.
• Google Maps Review Ritual: When a student picks up their glazed, finished pieces (the emotional peak of delight), send a direct Google review link via WhatsApp: "¡Qué hermosas quedaron tus piezas! ¿Me regalarías una reseña cortita con foto en Google Maps? Me ayuda un montón como taller independiente."
• Instagram Story Tags: Mentioning @taller.lento in stories earns students a free special studio glaze sample or mini dipping bowl.
• "Regalá una Experiencia" Vouchers: Offer printable gift vouchers for a Taster Class (ARS 40,000) or 1 Month (ARS 120,000), promoted on Instagram before birthdays and holidays.
